reference.name: Talon Knife Doppler Ruby broadside
reference.evidenceBoundary: Single broadside image; thickness and unseen surfaces are estimates for both reconstructions.

observedStrengths: three blade openings and a closed finger ring

glbRoundTrip.verificationMode: headless geometry and material scalars; reference-derived maps excluded

verdict.reason: Both routes project the admitted front plate. In the inspected Talon implementation img2threejs uses the plate with scalar roughness and no normal/roughness maps, while Morphloom derives aligned normal plus roughness maps for all 25 materials, compiles a closed-mesh cutting wedge whose 14/14 traced edge segments measure at most 0.12 mm, then proves closed topology and GLB round-trip. The verdict is limited to reference-driven surface response and modeled edge geometry, not unseen rear-face accuracy.
